purpose: Static state-machine and pooled-child motion evidence for falling leaves 0x29-0x2B.

state_machine.visibility: 01F7:47E7 calls the shared visibility gate; the false/off-camera branch calls shared removal 01F7:1DEE.
state_machine.visible_motion: The callback adds object+0x0E to object+0x06 each update after the MAP helper succeeds.
state_machine.blocked_state: On a blocked helper result it decrements object+0x32, toggles the sprite high bit, and returns until the timer expires.
state_machine.respawn_state: When object+0x32 reaches zero, it restores object+0x02/+0x06 from +0x2A/+0x2E, resets +0x32=0x000C, clears the slot high bit, and chooses a new table/random velocity.

conclusions: The leaf family has a decoded initializer, fixed-point vertical motion, blocked/timer/reseed state machine, and shared off-camera removal path.
Leaves are visual pooled children; 01F7:0E06 identifies a free entry by object+0x18 == 0. No player collision response is present in the child callback.
